description: This file implements the StorageManager class for managing storage operations such as create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage for applications within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes methods for configuration, storage management, and interaction with a RequestHandler singleton.

classes.name: StorageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Class responsible for managing storage operations such as create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage for applications within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: ~StorageManagerImplementation
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and releasing references.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the storage manager with the provided service, setting paths and initializing storage.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified app ID with a given size, returning the storage path.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage information and location for a specified app ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specified app ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specified app ID.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all storage data except for exempted app IDs.
